planner_id.used_as: planners aspect=all / list / get. Read-only in this release.

task_id_object_type.used_as: Internal TaskID of an object-type template (account_config task_templates; object settings URL objectId=). Not the user-facing number.

task_general_id.used_as: User-facing task number (GeneralID). Cite this in chat. tasks list object= filter. Not internal TaskID.

source_template_id.used_as: Template TaskID shown as clone source on an object type (account_config task_templates). Read-only in this release.

status_set_id_source.used_as: Process id on a template (automation status_sets / expand). Read-only in this release.

status_set_id_own.used_as: Object type's own process id after it has a dedicated status set. Read via automation status_sets.

workspace_id.used_as: workspace aspect=get object=. list may be empty while Current.workSpaceId still exists.

object_type_class.used_as: Entity class 1/2/3/4 = task/project/contact/employee. Not a Deal/Ticket type id.
